phase: Phase 5 - Final Evaluation on Frozen Test Set
selection_rationale:
Model Selection Decision: Logistic Regression with balanced class weighting was selected as the final model based strictly on Phase 4.2 group-aware Out-Of-Fold (OOF) cross-validation results.
Key comparative factors:
1. Highest Balanced Accuracy: 0.5195 (only candidate exceeding 0.50 random chance across all 3 classes).
2. Highest Multiclass Discrimination: ROC-AUC OvR of 0.7731 (vs 0.7572 for RF and 0.7394 for XGBoost).
3. Clinically Viable Prediabetes Screening: Class 1 recall of 30.61% and Class 1 F1 of 0.0553 (detects 1,134 prediabetic cases in OOF vs only 18 cases for Random Forest [0.49% recall]).
4. Transparency & Interpretability: Direct linear log-odds coefficients enable exact risk attribution without black-box fragility.
5. Random Forest was rejected because it effectively collapses Class 1 (misses 99.51% of prediabetic patients), rendering it useless for early disease interception despite its high nominal majority-class accuracy.

split_information.row_discrepancy_explanation: Phase 3 metadata recorded 202,943 train / 50,737 test rows. Runtime StratifiedGroupKFold produces 202,944 train / 50,736 test rows. The 1-row discrepancy is confined to Class 2 (7,069 vs 7,070 rows; Classes 0 and 1 are exactly identical at 42,741 and 926 rows). This occurs because StratifiedGroupKFold clusters groups indivisibly, where a single 1-row group shifts across the split boundary depending on internal group hash ordering. Zero group overlap is preserved.

governance_and_limitations.clinical_status: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE ONLY - NOT FOR DIRECT CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS
governance_and_limitations.class_imbalance_impact: Severe imbalance (1.83% Class 1) drives low positive predictive value (3.0%) despite balanced class weighting.
governance_and_limitations.false_positive_consequence: Triggers secondary confirmatory laboratory screening (HbA1c/fasting plasma glucose); causes mild patient concern and modest healthcare resource utilization.
governance_and_limitations.false_negative_consequence: Delays early prediabetes lifestyle/dietary intervention, allowing metabolic decline to progress toward overt type 2 diabetes.
governance_and_limitations.generalization_conclusion: OOF and Test metrics match within ±0.5% relative error across all key parameters, confirming a minimal generalization gap and consistent out-of-sample performance across isolated groups.
